product.name: EmuChef
product.purpose: Guide nontechnical Android handheld owners through one reviewed installation and configuration journey on Apple Silicon macOS, with optional simulation, model/brand recommendations, logical storage, generated app settings, and separately qualified direct-ADB/OEM-assisted execution; Rust/Tauri alone holds trusted authority and Config Editor feature work is deferred.

primary_users.role: Nontechnical Android handheld owner using EmuChef proper
primary_users.technical_level: Nontechnical and needs clear guidance instead of runtime or protocol concepts
primary_users.work_context: Uses native Apple Silicon macOS/Tauri with one connected device: selects supported setup, internal/SD content and app settings, reviews exact scoped actions, then applies only through a separately qualified and authorized executor or OEM user-mediated script stage.

primary_users.role: Technical author maintaining Config Editor catalog content
primary_users.technical_level: Technical and responsible for authored recipes, application definitions, device profiles, and validation evidence
primary_users.work_context: Maintains App Definitions, Recipes, Device Profiles and Plans; Config Editor new feature work is deferred except safe typed-schema compatibility and refuse-unsafe-save behavior.

jobs_to_be_done.statement: Configure a supported Android handheld through a guided, reproducible workflow.
Review exact installation, configuration, backup and copy effects; optionally simulate before an authorized supported execution.
Apply an explicitly enabled and separately qualified configuration while preserving truthful status and recovery behavior.
Establish automated, evidence-backed qualification for an authored workflow before broader release or physical-device claims.
Create, validate, and maintain recipes, application definitions, device profiles, and generated catalog content.
Inspect bounded diagnostics and recover unsaved intent or failed workflow state without requiring a terminal.

must_reduce: Authority confusion between Rust/Tauri and React
Unrecoverable failures and loss of user intent
Leakage of sensitive device or configuration data
must_not_become: A generic shell or device-management tool
An automatic license-acceptance or SDK-acquisition path
A product that implies rollback capabilities the runtime does not provide
experience_principles: Mandatory immutable review; simulation is optional
Trusted Rust/Tauri authority with sanitized presentation
Explicit separation of EmuChef proper and Config Editor
Evidence before qualification or release claims
End-user device compatibility uses supported or not supported language; qualification and evidence terminology stays internal to engineering and operator workflows
Internal qualification tooling observes the ordinary EmuChef workflow and never creates a parallel source of device, planning, review, or execution authority
OEM-assisted execution is a Device Profile-owned user-invoked strategy, not direct ADB root; invoked attempts preserve immutable evidence and cleanup warnings remain separately tracked.
